001package io.github.ai4ci.config.setup;
002
003import org.immutables.value.Value;
004
005import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeInfo;
006import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeName;
007import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonDeserialize;
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize;
009
010import io.github.ai4ci.abm.ModifiablePerson;
011import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Outbreak;
012import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Person;
013import io.github.ai4ci.util.Conversions;
014import io.github.ai4ci.util.Sampler;
015
016/**
017 * Location aware demographic configuration.
018 *
019 * <p>
020 * This interface provides simple helpers for demographies that incorporate
021 * spatial information. It defines a proximity based modifier and utility
022 * methods used during setup and relationship strength calculation.
023 * Implementations are used by the model builder during the setup stage to place
024 * people and to inform contact probabilities between agents.
025 *
026 * <p>
027 * Downstream uses include
028 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.builders.DefaultModelBuilder#setupOutbreak}
029 * during outbreak construction and the per‑person baseliner which may consult
030 * proximity when assigning household or workplace links.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * Extension guidance: subclasses may override {@link #getRelationshipStrength}
034 * to combine alternative spatial kernels or to use data driven lookup tables.
035 * Keep heavy data loads in the setup stage rather than per‑person methods.
036 *
037 * @author Rob Challen
038 */
039@Value.Immutable
040@JsonSerialize(as = ImmutableLocationAwareDemography.class)
041@JsonDeserialize(as = ImmutableLocationAwareDemography.class)
042@JsonTypeInfo(use = JsonTypeInfo.Id.NAME)
043@JsonTypeName("location-aware")
044public interface LocationAwareDemography extends DemographicConfiguration {
045
046        /**
047         * Sensible default configuration for location aware demography used in
048         * examples and tests.
049         */
050        ImmutableLocationAwareDemography DEFAULT = ImmutableLocationAwareDemography
051                .builder()
052                .setDescription(
053                        "An increased association between contact strength and proximity (OR=2)."
054                )
055                .setContactProximityBias(2.0)
056                .build();
057
058        /**
059         * Create a minimal person stub attached to the supplied outbreak.
060         *
061         * <p>
062         * Used by setup helpers that need a quick person object for sampling or
063         * placement. Implementations may extend the returned stub further in later
064         * stages.
065         *
066         * @param outbreak owning outbreak used to attach the created person
067         * @return a modifiable person stub
068         */
069        @Override
070        default ModifiablePerson createPersonStub(Outbreak outbreak) {
071                var tmp = Person.createPersonStub(outbreak);
072                return tmp;
073        }
074
075        /**
076         * Calibrates the strength of association between distance and contact
077         * probability. Values above 1 compress contact radius; values below 1 expand
078         * it.
079         *
080         * @return proximity bias applied to base contact odds
081         */
082        Double getContactProximityBias();
083
084        /**
085         * Compute a relationship strength between two people based on spatial
086         * proximity.
087         *
088         * <p>
089         * The returned value is an odds/probability modifier used by higher level
090         * code when composing demographic and location based contact modifiers.
091         * Implementations that need alternative kernels should override this method.
092         *
093         * @param source  the source person
094         * @param target  the target person
095         * @param sampler a sampler for stochastic sampling when required
096         * @return a relationship strength used as an odds modifier
097         */
098        @Override
099        default double getRelationshipStrength(
100                        Person source, Person target, Sampler sampler
101        ) {
102                return Conversions.scaleProbabilityByOR(
103                        this.getProximity(source, target),
104                        1 / this.getContactProximityBias()
105                );
106        }
107
108}
